LanguageData.MST.title: Title
LanguageData.MST.titleComment: Title shown for this backstory. Leave the female variants empty to use this one for both genders.
LanguageData.MST.titleFemaleComment: Title used for female pawns; falls back to the plain title when empty.
LanguageData.MST.titleShortComment: Abbreviated title (used where space is tight), e.g. in the social log.
LanguageData.MST.titleShortFemaleComment: Abbreviated title for female pawns; falls back to the plain short title when empty.
LanguageData.MST.descriptionComment: Backstory text shown in the character creation panel and the pawn's bio.
LanguageData.MST.identifierComment: Stable identifier used by the translation pipeline (language export/import). It has no effect on gameplay.
LanguageData.MST.slotComment: Which life stage this backstory fills: Childhood or Adulthood.
LanguageData.MST.workDisablesComment: Work types (by WorkTags) this backstory forbids the pawn from doing.
LanguageData.MST.possessionsComment: Items handed out at character creation. The count is a range (min~max) rolled per pawn and clamped to 1..stack limit. Vanilla uses at most 2 of them per pawn.
LanguageData.MST.spawnCategoriesComment: Category tags deciding which pawn groups this backstory may appear in (e.g. Pirate, Tribal, Child). A shuffleable backstory needs at least one.
LanguageData.MST.bodyTypeGlobalComment: Body type forced regardless of gender. When empty, the gender-specific entries below are used.
LanguageData.MST.bodyTypeFemaleComment: Body type granted to female pawns (ignored while the global body type is set).
LanguageData.MST.bodyTypeMaleComment: Body type granted to male pawns (ignored while the global body type is set).
LanguageData.MST.nameMakerComment: Rule pack used to generate names for pawns carrying this backstory.
LanguageData.MST.shuffleableComment: Whether this backstory is randomly assigned to new pawns. Turn off to remove it from the random pool.
LanguageData.MST.requiresSpawnCategoryComment: Whether a spawn category is mandatory for this backstory to be used at all.
